details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 240-247 (`normalize_path`) and lines 536-716 (`emit_context`) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing credential-bearing paths such as `.git/config`, `.ssh/config`, `.aws/credentials`, and `.env*` to be inlined into model prompts.
  WHY: Attacker-controlled issue or plan text can cause credential files to pass repository containment checks and be read into model context, reversing the prior exfiltration control.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 (`emit_context`) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and complete output-budget accounting were removed.
  WHY: Large or marker-only path lists can generate output beyond `max_bytes` and consume unbounded model-context and subprocess work; severity disagreement exists, with mistralai_mistral-small-2603 rating the marker-output defect BLOCKER while the other reviewers rated related budget defects MAJOR.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_git_subprocess_env` (lines 2987-2990), `_inject_token_into_url` (lines 3038-3055), `_resolve_origin_url` (lines 3074-3087) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS repository URLs after per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: Git arguments, process listings, clone/fetch/push errors, and diagnostics can expose the token.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` (lines ~542-592, token-bearing printf at ~line 585); `memory_ensure_branch` (lines 137-186) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, force-tick URLs embed tokens, and `memory_ensure_branch` uses unauthenticated bare Git commands.
  WHY: Git failures can leak credentials and private-repository branch creation can fail because no per-command authentication remains.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deletion of `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` family (former lines 493-512 and 947-1372) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval helpers and Git authentication helpers were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Approval requests, validation, consumed markers, successor handling, and terminal review-blocked actions become no-ops or fail closed, permanently stalling affected PRs.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest` (lines 766-780), `gh_pr_with_all_comments` GraphQL query (lines 833-947) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment identity fields `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association` were removed and the sort contract changed.
  WHY: Approval and producer checks receive missing identity fields, so authenticated review-blocked approvals cannot be found or validated; ordering also becomes nondeterministic.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: line 2002 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth push origin "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"` invokes a deleted helper without a guard.
  WHY: The `[judge-fix]` commit is never pushed, preventing review-blocked recovery.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-66 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` guard changed from a HEAD check with index and worktree restoration to an index check with worktree-only restoration.
  WHY: Staged generated files can cause restore failure, while staged deletions or modifications can remain in the index and be committed unintentionally.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: `model_provider_broker_stop` (lines 190-216) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Broker shutdown returns on ACL or ownership restoration failures before completing broker termination.
  WHY: The credential-holding broker can remain alive, and EXIT traps can turn successful model steps into failed jobs; severity disagreement exists, with mistralai_mistral-small-2603 rating the cleanup leak MAJOR and the other reviewers also rating this defect MAJOR.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: `_resolver_exit_trap` (lines 317-325) and `_resolver_restore_agent_access` stub (line 307) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Early exits can invoke the stub `_resolver_restore_agent_access` before the real implementation is defined.
  WHY: ACL grants can remain active when setup fails before the real restoration function is declared.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh: lines 9-17; `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4937-4944` | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The actuate step runs for non-orchestrator conflicted PRs when `RESOLVER_ACTUATION_REQUIRED=true` and requires missing integration-sync context.
  WHY: `if: always()` causes ordinary conflicted PRs to fail with `Resolver actuation context is invalid.` instead of falling through to review-blocked handling.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh: lines 20-24 (head SHA validation) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A stale-head early exit does not unset `RESOLVER_ACTUATION_REQUIRED`.
  WHY: Discarded retry state can still trigger an unnecessary force-tick dispatch.

- .github/workflows/clarify.yml: lines 219, 232-233, 253-254, 272-273, 293-294, 314-315, 337-338, 348-349 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Mutable `.codex-workflow-src-main` fallbacks remain and support execution still assigns `SCRIPT_REF=stable`.
  WHY: Consumer workflows can execute mutable support code while holding credentials, defeating immutable workflow-reference hardening.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml: line assigning `SCRIPT_REF=stable` | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrate workflow still assigns `SCRIPT_REF=stable` and retains mutable fallback paths.
  WHY: The workflow can execute mutable support code instead of an immutable workflow SHA while holding credentials.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: `model_provider_broker_start` (lines 162-194) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: One broker instance imposes a shared hard cap of 12 upstream requests without per-phase overrides or direct-provider fallback.
  WHY: Normal retry and multi-phase workflows can exhaust the cap, causing subsequent model phases to fail with 429 responses.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-38, 694-748, 762-781 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports and exercises deleted symbols `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, so the targeted-context contract tests cannot run.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 51-55, 99-102, 118-133, 271-334, 337-343, 372-373, 376-406 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing contract tests still require credential-free Git URLs, `_memory_git`, and review-blocked helpers.
  WHY: The deleted helpers and token-bearing URLs cause the Git-auth and review-blocked contract tests to fail.

- scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh: line 176 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The consumer retro fan-out still runs Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while processing workflow-log-derived text.
  WHY: Prompt-injected log content can access the provider key or mutate the repository through this uncovered sibling model path.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh / .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: `review_conflict_resolve.sh` no longer writes `RESOLVER_ESCALATED`; `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6599, 6669, 6694` | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The new V2 candidate/actuate flow no longer sets `RESOLVER_ESCALATED=true` or posts the escalation summary.
  WHY: Failure-notification steps can emit duplicate alerts and the PR loses the human-readable escalation summary.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml / scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh / scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: actuate step at review_autofix.yml:4937-4944; scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh lines 9-17 and 71-77; scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh _resolver_exit_trap lines 313-323 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Resolver failure state and `if: always()` broaden credential-bearing actuation beyond integration-sync conflicts.
  WHY: Non-orchestrator failures enter a second hard-failing mutation path instead of the prior clean no-op.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: lines 27-28 (variable-naming comment mentioning GH_PAT) | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: A variable-naming comment still references `GH_PAT` in a context suggesting lingering credential-handling confusion.
  WHY: The comment can mislead maintainers about whether credentials remain in the resolver environment.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh, scripts/self_heal_validation.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh, scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh still uses `--sandbox danger-full-access`; scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, and other sibling model paths still expose provider or repository credentials; the PR only covers clarify, plan, orchestrate, orchestrate_clarify_respond, workflow-log-analysis, and review_conflict_resolve.

- requirement: "Pin support checkouts to an immutable commit SHA, verify the resolved commit, and remove mutable main fallbacks."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml, .github/workflows/plan.yml, .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml, .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, .github/workflows/implement.
